verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API platform, so in-product AI insights over a user's data (for example, usage or billing data in the console) is a fair question. The evidence describes only inference primitives: chat completions, structured outputs, tool use, remote MCP and batch. These are developer building blocks for building such a feature, not a documented in-product insights capability. The only console-side data feature is spend limits and budget alerts, which is an adjacent control and not AI-generated insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
